name: imf_get_data
description:
Any IMF series: a database (dataflow id) and an SDMX key, or, for databases keyed COUNTRY.INDICATOR.FREQUENCY (WEO, MFS_IR), a country, an indicator code and a frequency. Keys use ISO alpha-3 countries; + joins codes, an empty position takes all (PCPS key G001.PGOLD.USD.M: gold, USD per troy ounce, monthly).
Returns: database, key, series (key, dimensions, name, data (period, value) oldest first), count, source; a note when nothing matched.
Inputs (* required): database* (WEO, CPI, ER, MFS_IR, IL, BOP, PCPS, ...; imf_get_databases lists them); key (full SDMX key; imf_get_dataflows shows its dimensions) or country_code with indicator_code; frequency (A, Q, M; default A; used only without key); start_year, end_year.
For curated indicators use imf_get_weo_data, imf_get_ifs_data, imf_get_bop_data.
Example: {"database": "PCPS", "key": "G001.PGOLD.USD.M", "start_year": 2025}

database.description: IMF dataflow id, e.g. WEO, CPI, PCPS

key.description: Full SDMX key, dimensions joined by dots

country_code.description: Country: ISO alpha-3 (USA) or alpha-2 (US); IMF group codes such as G001 (world) pass through

indicator_code.description: Indicator code, with country_code, for COUNTRY.INDICATOR.FREQUENCY databases

frequency.description: A annual, Q quarterly, M monthly (only without key)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Generic tool for accessing any IMF database. Use specialized tools like imf_get_ifs_data or imf_get_weo_data for easier access to common indicators.

examples.description: Gold price, USD per troy ounce, monthly
